findings.detail: The derived holding identifier embeds MIWD Holdco Interest Rate 8.84%, but the raw SOI row and structured interest_rate show 8.35%.
The derived holding identifier embeds Iris Buyer LLC delayed draw Interest Rate 11.58%, but the raw SOI row and structured interest_rate show 10.85%.

rationale: Class 2 within-row adjudication. The fmt_basis_spread flag is grounded by rows where the derived bdc_investment_identifier carries an interest-rate value that does not match the raw schedule. For MIWD Holdco, the bundle identifier says Interest Rate 8.84% while the raw SOI row prints S + 350 and 8.35%, matching the structured interest_rate. For Iris Buyer LLC delayed draw, the bundle identifier says Interest Rate 11.58% while the raw SOI row prints S + 625 (100 Floor) and 10.85%, again matching the structured interest_rate. The defect is localized to the formatted identifier/source-field assembly, not the numeric interest_rate extraction.
